title: Recover a low-support unknown channel at the correct quality metric
status_authority: Actual completed low-support recovery, conventional SDP/gap-free synthesis and uniform finite-design compiler receiving reviews acquired with their dependency receipts and stated metrics.
reported_status: Actual completed low-support recovery, conventional SDP/gap-free synthesis and uniform finite-design compiler receiving reviews acquired with their dependency receipts and stated metrics.
scientific_scope_status: Completed scoped internal reviews extend coherent joint-training recovery from a perfect mixed encoder to arbitrary stationary memoryless channels with supplied low OUTPUT-support dimension. Learned physical Petz gives entanglement fidelity>=Fopt^2-3delta-beta-gamma; a separately accepted conventional small recovery SDP gives>=Fopt-2delta-zeta-beta-gamma. The accepted finite local-design/Schur compiler removes the old fixed-d enumeration exponent as a theoretical algorithm.

unavailable_or_unclassified: Low output support or supplied Kraus-rank bound is a promise, not learned exact rank. Lossy channels need not recover near identity. The metric is maximally mixed-reference entanglement fidelity, not diamond-near-optimality or approximation of the true sourcePetz map. Joint coherent outputs/references and later payload storage are mandatory. Uniform polynomial compiler has huge constants and unexecuted certified arithmetic/gate list; dimensions/padding/control errors remain paid. Forward-only physical Petz and conventional SDP are prior; no priority, device or practical advantage is accepted.
